name: Bot Tank — Cuerpo
generation_strategy: IMAGEN COMBINADA 1536×1024 con bot body (izquierda) y cannon (derecha). Mismo cannon que el default pero tintado diferente en-game.

frames.role: Cuerpo del tanque bot (IA de relleno) — visualmente distinto al jugador
frames.prompt:
TWO cartoon game sprites side by side on a single 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Both viewed strictly from directly above at 90 degrees (pure bird's eye zenith view). STYLE: vibrant cartoon game art — same quality as Brawl Stars, bold dark charcoal outlines, cel-shading with smooth gradients.

LEFT PANEL (left half): Robot/AI BOT TANK BODY, top-down view, only the roof visible. Cool muted blue-gray (#778899) color — clearly different from the warm orange player tank. The roof surface has: angular geometric armor panels (more angular/mechanical than the player tank), a small cylindrical antenna/sensor on the rear section visible from above, a single bright red circular sensor dot on one panel (AI eye/sensor), ventilation slots, mechanical panel lines. TWO SEGMENTED TRACK STRIPS on left and right edges with individual track links visible from above. Cel-shading: cool blue-gray highlight, mid blue-gray base, darker blue-gray shadow. Drop shadow. Chunky squat proportions.

RIGHT PANEL (right half): Same CANNON as the default player cannon — narrow elongated rectangle pointing UP (12 o'clock), base is wider rounded rectangle. Cool blue-gray color (#4A5566) to match the bot aesthetic. Same cel-shading quality.

Both: strictly top-down 90-degree overhead. NO front face, NO side face. Professional 2D game art.
frames.negative_prompt: side view, isometric, angled, front face, warm orange colors, realistic, pixel art, military, text, watermark, solid background

phaser_config.notes: Usa el mismo cañón que el default (tank-default-cannon) con tint gris (#AAAAAA).
